description: Search dental providers by name, city, ZIP, state, specialty, license status and expiry, discipline, practice size, DSO or independent, new registrations, Medicaid state-roster enrollment, a verified website and what the site mentions (scanners, implants, aligners, sedation). Results include BOTH individual dentists and organizations (group practices, DSO-owned offices, clinics), interleaved alphabetically; pass entity_type=individual|organization to narrow, and read meta.entity_counts to see the split across the whole result set rather than just the current page. Returns a paginated list with citation envelope. Use for discovery and territory exploration. Filters compose with AND. Works without auth on a free tier (10 requests/day per IP, 10 rows/page) returning directory-grade fields only (identity + location); a Bearer token (ps_live_*) unlocks phone, license status, DSO affiliation, disciplinary and CMS-biller fields, the verified website and its mentions, a closing-or-changed-hands status, every filter marked Bearer only, and full pagination.

closed.description: Bearer only. only = rows flagged likely closed or changed hands, hide = leave them out.

discipline.description: Bearer only. true = current or historical board discipline.

entity_type.description: Narrow to individual dentists or to organizations (group practices, DSO-owned offices, clinics). Omit to get both, interleaved alphabetically.

enum_days.description: Bearer only. Registered with NPPES in the last N days.

exp_months.description: Bearer only. License expires within this many months.

is_dso.description: Bearer only. true = DSO-affiliated, false = independent.

medicaid.description: Bearer only. true = provider is state-listed on a Medicaid enrolled-provider roster. State-listed enrollment, not verified acceptance.

min_practice_size.description: Bearer only. Dentists at the same building, at least.

retirement_risk.description: Bearer only. true = graduation year, age range or license age near retirement.

sedation_permit.description: Bearer only. true = holds a sedation permit.

site.description: Bearer only. What the practice's website mentions: any.<family> (scanner, mill, imaging, lasers, implants, aligners, sedation, services, software, money, payers, languages) or a catalog key such as equipment.scanner.itero. Join with | for or, with a comma for and.

specialty.description: Bearer only. Exact specialty (e.g. General Dentist, Orthodontics).

state.description: Two-letter state code (e.g. NM, TX, FL).

website.description: Bearer only. true = has a verified practice website, false = has none on file.

name: search_providers
